bosses.name: Li Li
bosses.strategy:
At least this time she won't use Dark Messenger, but she still uses
Paralysis (which, again, does decent damage, but you should be guarded
against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets.) Watch
out for Hate Storm, as it'll do decent damage to your whole party.
Start off by healing, if needed. As with the last battle, if you have it,
have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow attack; it should
do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she
has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret
should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever
the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really need a second healer,
Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its Sacred Remedy will heal
EVERYONE in the party, especially after Hate Storm.
If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or
Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this
point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting
Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on
her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based
attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light REPEATEDLY. Margaret will be
the primary healer once again, as Yuri and Alice should be shelling out
some pretty wicked damage to Li Li. Use Thera and Mana Leaves whenever
the party's HP/MP are getting low, and you should be fine.

When you gain control of a very queasy Yuri, open the chest on the left side of
the room for a [_ROSEWOOD BRACELET_]. Go up the stairs to the right for some
dialogue with Margarete, then go down and left, examining the door to the
wheelhouse for a scene. Afterward, head left a bit more, then check the top
barrel to the upper-right for a [_WITCH'S BROTH_]. Move left and talk to
Zhuzhen, then make your way back below deck to talk with Alice for a long
scene.

You'll regain control under the deck as just Yuri. Save your game, then go back
out on deck. Head inside the wheelhouse and take out the group of monsters
here. Afterward, before leaving, check the floor near the wheel and the blanket
hanging for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go back outside and downstairs to take out a
second group of enemies, and after they're finished, go back out on the deck
and talk to Zhuzhen to fight one last group.

  NOTE     It should be fairly easy to obtain both your level 1 Fire and Water
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Fusions here, since the enemies come in groups of 3 and 4. I
           strongly recommend doing so, as it won't take long at all. Also,
           make sure Alice it at least level 11 so that she learns the
           Blessed Light spell.

Once they're done, and Zhuzhen is finished with the preparations, make your way
back down to below the deck and save your game. Before continuing, stop in the
wheelhouse once more and talk to the Courier Subordinate, who's asking if you
need anything in a strange way.

———————————————————————————————
   [1] Yes, of course.
   [2] What are you saying?!
———————————————————————————————

Choosing option 1 will allow you to see what items he has for sale. Make sure
that you have THREE Rosewood Bracelets to put on your active party, as the next
boss can paralyze you. Also make sure to have enough healing items.

Choosing option 2 will allow you to discover that he's actually a Lottery
Member!

The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it
easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Iron Clogs before continuing on;
it slows down the indicator speed on your Judgment Ring, but it also lowers
your Agl 15 points. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

When you're prepared for the next boss, go back and talk to Zhuzhen. He'll ask
if you're ready.

————————————————————
   [1] Not yet.
   [2] Any time!!
————————————————————

Choose option 2, and after an event, you'll be thrown into a battle.

Next stop: Shanghai! Make sure to remove your accessories from your party
before entering, as you'll be controlling Zhuzhen for a short time.
